population.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

endpoint.span: The primary efficacy endpoint, change from baseline to day 28 in Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale (MADRS) score

estimate.span:
RESULT OUTCOME 0 DENOM Participants: Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=101; Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=100
RESULT OUTCOME 0 MEASUREMENT : Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD)=-21.4 (spread 12.32); Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD=-17.0 (spread 13.88)

analysis_set.span: Full analysis set (FAS) defined as all randomized participants who received at least 1 dose of intranasal study medication, 1 dose of oral antidepressant (AD) medication during double-blind induction phase (D-BIP).

treatment_strategy.span: Confirmed nonresponders were randomly assigned to treatment with esketamine nasal spray (56 or 84 mg twice weekly) and an antidepressant or antidepressant and placebo nasal spray.

absent_reason: ci: No held source reports a confidence interval for the observed-case raw between-arm change-score MD. The reported confidence intervals belong to MMRM or ANCOVA least-square mean differences and cannot be attached to the raw means.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 0 ANALYSIS 0: groups Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD), Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD | Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -4.0 (95% CI -7.31 to -0.64) | p =0.020 | METHOD Mixed Model for Repeated Measures
candidate_rejections.why: This model-based least-square mean difference and CI do not estimate the served observed-case raw mean difference.

candidate_rejections.span: RESULT OUTCOME 1 ANALYSIS 0: groups Intranasal Esketamine (Esk) Plus Oral Antidepressant (AD), Intranasal Placebo Plus Oral AD | Difference of Least Square (LS) Means -3.5 (95% CI -6.67 to -0.26) | p =0.034 | METHOD ANCOVA
candidate_rejections.why: This ANCOVA estimate uses the endpoint with last observation carried forward, rather than the served observed-case Day-28 raw change scores.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults with nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode fall within the question's adult treatment-resistant depression population.
entry_population_matches_question.span: The study enrolled adults with moderate to severe nonpsychotic depression and a history of nonresponse to at least two antidepressants in the current episode, with one antidepressant assessed prospectively.

notes: Registry spans are used for the raw arm summaries and FAS definition. The registry explicitly identifies outcome 0 dispersion as Standard Deviation. Served arm summaries match the source. No raw MD or CI was calculated; the missing CI prevents BOUND status.
